changelog:
Replaced folder-style settings navigation with direct area tabs for faster switching without nested submenus.
System, parental and player settings open their first area immediately and remember the selected tab across page recreation.
Kept account and setup controls available across areas; search still covers all settings and opens the matching tab.
Back now closes search or leaves the settings page directly, without an intermediate folder overview.
Added accessible selected-tab labels and improved remote navigation between the toolbar, scrollable tabs and setting controls.
message: Dev build v848 - Direct settings tabs without folder navigation
